constraints: All ranges passed (rangeObj, otherRangeObj, and any further otherRangeObjN) must belong to the same 4D View Pro area.
The command incorporates the passed range objects by reference, not by copy.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns a new range object that combines two or more existing range objects (by reference) from the same 4D View Pro area into a single combined range.
